title: Academy Signature: dashboard, typography and shared learning design
summary: Implement a unified forest-and-cream interface, bundled Arabic typography, real-state dashboard, five-destination navigation, and coordinated teacher, lesson, profile and practice surfaces.

changes.detail: Locally bundled licensed Arabic regular/semibold fonts; reusable icon, metric, tool and decorative brand components.
Dashboard composition, semantic theme, typography, navigation, teacher welcome, lesson header and profile. Progress and recommendations use actual existing state.
Removed My Learning and More from the visible bottom bar; their routes and access from Home/Profile remain.
Dark sign-in and status-bar detection updated for new palette; corrupted flashcard launchpad text replaced.

validation.name: Source audit
validation.detail: Inventoried all app routes and reviewed shared components, teacher, practice, course and persistence integration.

validation.name: Initial type check
validation.detail: Found dashboard course lesson shape, title tuple and launchpad optional title errors; corrected before next validation.

validation.name: Visual and regression validation
validation.detail: Implementation in progress. Fresh export, browser checks, tests and native export pending. No deployment.
